decision.question: Given the cellular connectivity symptoms, diagnostic evidence so far, and only these admissible tools, which next tool is most useful for safely advancing service restoration? Do not assume an unverified recovery path works.

excluded.evaluate_profile_change: active profile registers normally (99.7%); a profile switch has no causal path to recovery

data_path.summary: cellular + APN healthy; ingestion endpoint rejecting payloads since deploy ingest-v2.14

explanation:
**What the agent did:** It checked the data path first. Cellular attach and APN were healthy, but the ingest endpoint returned HTTP 5xx on 98% of requests, and the summary links this to deploy ingest-v2.14. It then checked the device: firmware was uniform, the modem was healthy, and there was no reject cause. With low confidence (0.09), it chose escalate-or-wait and escalated. It excluded retries, operator changes, and profile changes because registration was already healthy.

**Observed:** App ack rate stayed at 0.02 before and after the run. Attach (0.997), data session (0.99), and heartbeat (0.99) were unchanged. The run did not restore service.

**Uncertain:** Whether ingest-v2.14 caused the failure. The link is stated in the summary but not tested. Why the device check was judged insufficient. Whether any remediation was attempted, since the trace shows none.

result.summary: cellular + APN healthy; ingestion endpoint rejecting payloads since deploy ingest-v2.14
